exercises.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
exercises.desc: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Place your hands behind or to the side of your head.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hamstring
exercises.desc: Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out. With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercises.desc: Select a light resistance and sit down on the ab machine placing your feet under the pads provided and grabbing the top handles. At the same time, begin to lift the legs up as you crunch your upper torso.

exercises.name: Ab Roller
exercises.desc: Hold the Ab Roller with both hands and kneel on the floor. Now place the ab roller on the floor in front of you so that you are on all your hands and knees (as in a kneeling push up position).

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.desc: Kneel holding an ab wheel and roll forward as far as you can with a neutral spine, then pull back with the abs.

exercises.name: Active Hang
exercises.desc: Hang from the bar and pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows. Hold.

exercises.name: Adductor
exercises.desc: Lie face down with one leg on a foam roll. Rotate the leg so that the foam roll contacts against your inner thigh.

exercises.name: Adductor/Groin
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with your feet raised towards the ceiling. Have your partner hold your feet or ankles.

exercises.name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.desc: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm. Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push your butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell.

exercises.name: Air Bike
exercises.desc: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand. Use your hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.

exercises.name: Alternate Hammer Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The palms of the hands should be facing your torso.

exercises.name: Alternate Heel Touchers
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor with the knees bent and the feet on the floor around 18-24 inches apart. Crunch over your torso forward and up about 3-4 inches to the right side and touch your right heel as you hold the contraction for a second.

exercises.name: Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.desc: Sit down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the right weight forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
exercises.desc: Assume a comfortable stance with one foot slightly in front of the other. Begin by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite knee forward and as high as possible before landing.

exercises.name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
exercises.desc: Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight. Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward.

exercises.name: Alternating Deltoid Raise
exercises.desc: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side. Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.

exercises.name: Alternating Floor Press
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders. Position one in place on your chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward.

exercises.name: Alternating Hang Clean
exercises.desc: Place two kettlebells between your feet. Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell in a hanging position.

exercises.name: Alternating Kettlebell Press
exercises.desc: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Press one directly overhead by extending through the elbow, turning it so the palm faces forward while holding the other kettlebell stationary .

exercises.name: Alternating Kettlebell Row
exercises.desc: Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Pull one kettlebell off of the floor while holding on to the other kettlebell.

exercises.name: Alternating Renegade Row
exercises.desc: Place two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder width apart. Push one kettlebell into the floor and row the other kettlebell, retracting the shoulder blade of the working side as you flex the elbow, pulling it to your side.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.desc: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to hold yourself. Lift the right leg in the air (just around 2 inches from the floor) and perform a circular motion with the big toe.

exercises.name: Ankle On The Knee
exercises.desc: From a lying position, bend your knees and keep your feet on the floor. Place your ankle of one foot on your opposite knee.

exercises.name: Anterior Tibialis-SMR
exercises.desc: Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor. Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins.

exercises.name: Anti-Gravity Press
exercises.desc: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench. Lay on the bench face down.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up
exercises.desc: Wide grip; pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
exercises.desc: Very wide hands; lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, then alternate sides. A progression toward one-arm push-ups.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.desc: Stand up and extend your arms straight out by the sides. Slowly start to make circles of about 1 foot in diameter with each outstretched arm.

exercises.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
exercises.desc: Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent. Now to perform the movement, raise the dumbbells as you…

exercises.name: Around The Worlds
exercises.desc: Lay down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with the palms of the hands facing towards the ceiling. Now move the dumbbells by creating a semi-circle as you displace them from the initial position to over the head.

exercises.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
exercises.desc: Pistol squat holding a doorframe, post or band for balance; use as little help as possible.

exercises.name: Atlas Stone Trainer
exercises.desc: This trainer is effective for developing Atlas Stone strength for those who don't have access to stones, and are typically made from bar ends or heavy pipe. Begin by loading the desired weight onto the bar.

exercises.name: Atlas Stones
exercises.desc: Begin with the atlas stone between your feet. Pulling the stone into your torso, drive through the back half of your feet to pull the stone from the ground.

exercises.name: Axle Deadlift
exercises.desc: Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees until your shins contact the bar.

exercises.name: Back Flyes - With Bands
exercises.desc: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack. Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.

exercises.name: Back Lever (Tuck)
exercises.desc: From a skin-the-cat position, lower to horizontal facing down with knees tucked and arms straight. Hold.

exercises.name: Backward Drag
exercises.desc: Load a sled with the desired weight, attaching a rope or straps to the sled that you can hold onto. Begin the exercise by moving backwards for a given distance.

exercises.name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
exercises.desc: This exercise is best done with a partner. Begin standing a few meters in front of your partner, both facing the same direction.

exercises.name: Balance Board
exercises.desc: Place a balance board in front of you. Stand up on it and try to balance yourself.

exercises.name: Ball Leg Curl
exercises.desc: Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball. Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball.

exercises.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.desc: Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.desc: Anchor a band at face height and pull it toward your forehead, spreading your hands apart and rotating out.

exercises.name: Band Good Morning
exercises.desc: Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading your feet a small amount. Keeping your legs straight, extend through the hips to come to a near vertical position.

exercises.name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
exercises.desc: Loop the band around a post. Begin by bending at the hips, getting your butt back as far as possible.

exercises.name: Band Hip Adductions
exercises.desc: Anchor a band around a solid post or other object. Stand with your left side to the post, and put your right foot through the band, getting it around the ankle.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
exercises.desc: Band around your knees or ankles, half squat and take steps sideways keeping tension on the band.

exercises.name: Band Pull Apart
exercises.desc: Begin with your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands. Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out laterally to your sides.

exercises.name: Band Skull Crusher
exercises.desc: Secure a band to the base of a rack or the bench. Take hold of the band, raising your elbows so that the upper arm is perpendicular to the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Ab Rollout

exercises.name: Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees
exercises.desc: Hold an Olympic barbell loaded with 5-10lbs on each side and kneel on the floor. Now place the barbell on the floor in front of you so that you are on all your hands and knees (as in a kneeling push up position).

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
exercises.desc: Lie on a bench with eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched; lower the bar to your mid-chest and press it back up over your shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at a shoulder-width grip. While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline
exercises.desc: Lie against an incline bench, with your arms holding a barbell and hanging down in a horizontal line. While keeping the upper arms stationary, curl the weight up as high as you can while squeezing the biceps.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.desc: Bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip just outside your legs; brace, push the floor away and stand tall with the bar close to your body.

exercises.name: Barbell Full Squat
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: Begin seated on the ground with a loaded barbell over your legs. Begin the movement by driving through with your heels, extending your hips vertically through the bar.

exercises.name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press

exercises.name: Barbell Hack Squat
exercises.desc: Stand up straight while holding a barbell behind you at arms length and your feet at shoulder width. While keeping your head and eyes up and back straight, squat until your upper thighs are parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.desc: Upper back on a bench, barbell over your hips; drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
exercises.desc: Lie back on an incline bench. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
exercises.desc: Lie back on an Incline Bench. While keeping the arms straight, lift the bar by protracting your shoulder blades, raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Barbell Rear Delt Row

exercises.desc: Place a block about 12 inches in front of a flat bench. Sit on the bench and place the ball of your feet on the block.

exercises.name: Barbell Shoulder Press
exercises.desc: Sit on a bench with back support in a squat rack. Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip width, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug

exercises.name: Barbell Side Bend
exercises.desc: Stand up straight while holding a barbell placed on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck). While keeping your back straight and your head up, bend only at the waist to the right as far as possible.

exercises.name: Barbell Side Split Squat

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.desc: Bar on your upper back, feet about shoulder width; sit down between your hips to at least parallel, keeping your chest up, then drive back to standing.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat To A Bench
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Then, set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.

exercises.name: Barbell Step Ups

exercises.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
exercises.desc: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and a barbell across your upper back. Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop your hips.

exercises.name: Battling Ropes
exercises.desc: For this exercise you will need a heavy rope anchored at its center 15-20 feet away. Initiate the movement by rapidly raising one arm to shoulder level as quickly as you can.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.desc: Facing away from a low cable, arm slightly behind your body, curl the handle up for a stretched-position biceps curl.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.desc: On hands and feet with knees hovering low, crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl Sled Drags
exercises.desc: Wearing either a harness or a loose weight belt, attach the chain to the back so that you will be facing away from the sled. Begin by driving with legs, alternating left and right.

exercises.name: Bear Plank Hold
exercises.desc: On hands and toes with knees hovering an inch off the floor, back flat. Hold.

exercises.name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you. Place your hands behind your hand, and push your elbows back as far as you can.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.desc: Squat with the load hung from a hip belt so the spine isn't loaded; sit deep and stand tall.

exercises.name: Bench Jump
exercises.desc: Begin with a box or bench 1-2 feet in front of you. Perform a short squat in preparation for the jump; swing your arms behind you.

exercises.name: Bench Press - Powerlifting
exercises.desc: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible. However wide your grip, it should cover the ring on the bar.

exercises.name: Bench Press - With Bands
exercises.desc: Using a flat bench secure a band under the leg of the bench that is nearest to your head. Once the band is secure, grab it by both handles and lie down on the bench.

exercises.name: Bench Press with Chains
exercises.desc: Adjust the leader chain, shortening it to the desired length.Place the chains on the sleeves of the bar. Lying on the bench, get your head beyond the bar if possible.

exercises.name: Bench Sprint
exercises.desc: Stand on the ground with one foot resting on a bench or box with your heel close to the edge. Push off with your foot on top of the bench, extending through the hip and knee.

exercises.name: Bent Over Barbell Row

exercises.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
exercises.desc: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you. While keeping your back straight and maintaining the natural arch of your back, lean forward until your forehead touches the…

exercises.name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
exercises.desc: Select a weight and hold the handle of the low pulley with your right hand. Bend at the waist until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row
exercises.desc: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell. Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep your knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row
exercises.desc: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell. Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep your knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In

exercises.name: Bent Press
exercises.desc: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Begin my leaning to the side opposite the kettlebell, continuing until you are able to touch the ground with your free hand, keeping your eyes on the kettlebell.

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
exercises.desc: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell using a shoulder grip width. Hold the bar straight over your chest with a bend in your arms.

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
exercises.desc: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides. Now bend your knees at around a 75 degree angle and lift your feet off the floor by around 2 inches.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.desc: On your back, bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, alternating in a pedaling motion.

exercises.name: Bicycling
exercises.desc: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

exercises.name: Bicycling, Stationary
exercises.desc: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height. Select the desired option from the menu.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.desc: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg until level with your torso, pause, return and alternate.

exercises.name: Board Press
exercises.desc: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back.

exercises.name: Body Tricep Press
exercises.desc: Position a bar in a rack at chest height. Standing, take a shoulder width grip on the bar and step a yard or two back, feet together and arms extended so that you are leaning on the bar.

exercises.name: Body-Up
exercises.desc: Assume a plank position on the ground. Pressing your palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise your body from the ground.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Stand on the edge of a step, lower your heels for a stretch and rise as high as possible onto your toes.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Flyes
exercises.desc: Position two equally loaded EZ bars on the ground next to each other. Assume a push-up position over the bars, supporting your weight on your toes and hands with your arms extended and body straight.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Mid Row

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.desc: Feet shoulder width, arms forward for balance; sit your hips back and down to at least parallel, then stand up through your whole foot.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Step-Up
exercises.desc: Step onto a sturdy box or stair with one foot and stand all the way up, then step down under control.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
exercises.desc: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop your hips.

exercises.name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
exercises.desc: Connect a standard handle to each arm of a cable machine, and position them in the most downward position. Grab a Bosu Ball and position it in front and center of the cable machine.

exercises.name: Bottoms Up
exercises.desc: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees.

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
exercises.desc: Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand. Swing the kettlebell back forcefully and then reverse the motion forcefully.

exercises.name: Box Jump (Multiple Response)
exercises.desc: Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or platform approximately an arm's length away. Using the arms to aid in the initial burst, jump upward and forward, landing with feet simultaneously on top of the box or platform.

exercises.name: Box Skip
exercises.desc: You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart. Begin facing the first box with one leg slightly behind the other.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.desc: The box squat allows you to squat to desired depth and develop explosive strength in the squat movement. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Box Squat with Bands
exercises.desc: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Box Squat with Chains
exercises.desc: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you. To set up the chains, begin by looping the leader chain over the sleeves of the bar.

exercises.name: Brachialis-SMR
exercises.desc: Lie on your side, with your upper arm against the foam roller. Raise your hips off of the floor, supporting your weight on your arm and on your feet.

exercises.name: Bradford/Rocky Presses
exercises.desc: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar at shoulder level with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.desc: Swing your arms and jump forward as far as possible from both feet, landing softly in a squat.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.desc: Rear foot on a bench behind you, lower straight down until the back knee nears the floor and drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.desc: Squat down, kick your feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump the feet in and jump up with arms overhead.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.desc: Jog in place kicking your heels up toward your glutes quickly.

exercises.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
exercises.desc: Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent. Pushing mainly with your heels, lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight.

exercises.name: Butt-Ups
exercises.desc: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms. Arch your back slightly out rather than keeping your back completely straight.

exercises.name: Butterfly
exercises.desc: Sit on the machine with your back flat on the pad. Take hold of the handles.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
exercises.desc: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles. Begin by extending through the elbow, pressing the handles together straight in front of you.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch

exercises.name: Cable Deadlifts
exercises.desc: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. To begin, squat down be flexing your hips and knees until you can reach the handles.

exercises.name: Cable Iron Cross
exercises.desc: Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position, select the resistance to be used, and take a handle in each hand. Stand directly between both pulleys with your arms extended out to your sides.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Stand beside a low pulley, raise the handle out to the side to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension

exercises.desc: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Keeping your arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion each time until your arms are above your head.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand with your hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. Keeping your arms straight, quickly move your arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion.

exercises.name: Egyptian Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Hold an upright post and lean away from it, then do a single-arm cable lateral raise from the low pulley for extra range.

exercises.name: Elbow Circles
exercises.desc: Sit or stand with your feet slightly apart. Place your hands on your shoulders with your elbows at shoulder level and pointing out.

exercises.name: Elbow to Knee
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.

exercises.name: Elbows Back
exercises.desc: Stand up straight. Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.

exercises.name: Elevated Back Lunge
exercises.desc: Position a bar onto a rack at shoulder height loaded to an appropriate weight. Rack the bar onto your upper back, keeping your back arched and tight.

exercises.name: Elevated Cable Rows
exercises.desc: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height. Place it on the seat of the cable row machine.

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
exercises.desc: Pike push-up with feet on a box or bench so more bodyweight goes through the shoulders; a step toward handstand push-ups.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.desc: To begin, step onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Crunch
exercises.desc: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball. Lower your torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
exercises.desc: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position. Now place your lower shins on top of an exercise ball.

exercises.name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press. Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above your body.

exercises.name: External Rotation
exercises.desc: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it. Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree…

exercises.name: External Rotation with Band
exercises.desc: Choke the band around a post. Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side.

exercises.name: External Rotation with Cable
exercises.desc: Adjust the cable to the same height as your elbow. Grasp the handle with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up straight while holding an EZ curl bar at the wide outer handle. Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
exercises.desc: Using a close grip, lift the EZ bar and hold it with your elbows in as you lie on the bench. Keeping the upper arms stationary, lower the bar by allowing the elbows to flex.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.desc: Rope at upper-chest height; pull it toward your face while spreading the ends apart and rotating your hands back, squeezing the rear delts.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.desc: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk. After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight and your head up.

exercises.name: Fast Skipping
exercises.desc: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.

exercises.name: Finger Curls
exercises.desc: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width. Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
exercises.desc: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys. Lay flat on the bench and keep your feet on the ground.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
exercises.desc: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end. Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat).

exercises.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
exercises.desc: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end. Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench.

exercises.name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
exercises.desc: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you. Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.

exercises.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.desc: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable. Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright.

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.desc: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so.

exercises.name: Floor Press with Chains
exercises.desc: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.desc: On a flat bench lie facedown with the hips on the edge of the bench, the legs straight with toes high off the floor and with the arms on top of the bench holding on to the front edge. Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings and…

exercises.name: Foot-SMR
exercises.desc: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of your foot.

exercises.name: Forward Drag with Press
exercises.desc: Attach a dual handled chain or rope attachment to the sled. Begin the movement by moving forward for one step.

exercises.name: Frankenstein Squat
exercises.desc: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and your body during the clean and front squat. Place the barbell on the front of the shoulders, releasing your grip and extending your arms out in front of you.

exercises.name: Freehand Jump Squat
exercises.desc: Cross your arms over your chest. With your head up and your back straight, position your feet at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Freestanding Handstand
exercises.desc: Kick up to a handstand without a wall and balance using your fingers; stacked hips over shoulders, body tight.

exercises.name: Frog Hops
exercises.desc: Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up. Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
exercises.desc: On your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out, pump your hips up and squeeze the glutes.

exercises.name: Frog Sit-Ups
exercises.desc: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you. Now bend at the knees and place your outer thighs by the floor (or mat) as you make the soles of your feet touch each other.

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Front Box Jump
exercises.desc: Begin with a box of an appropriate height 1-2 feet in front of you. Perform a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging your arms behind you.

exercises.name: Front Cable Raise
exercises.desc: Select the weight on a low pulley machine and grasp the single hand cable attachment that is attached to the low pulley with your left hand. Face away from the pulley and put your arm straight down with the hand cable…

exercises.name: Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops)
exercises.desc: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart. Stand in front of the first cone with your feet shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Front Dumbbell Raise
exercises.desc: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift…

exercises.name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
exercises.desc: Sit down on an incline bench with the incline set anywhere between 30 to 60 degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand. Extend your arms straight in front of you and have your palms facing down with the dumbbells raised…

exercises.name: Front Leg Raises
exercises.desc: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand. Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight.

exercises.name: Front Lever (Tuck)
exercises.desc: Hang from a bar, pull your body horizontal with straight arms and knees tucked to the chest. Hold.

exercises.name: Front Plate Raise
exercises.desc: While standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions. Slowly raise the plate as you exhale until it is a little above shoulder level.

exercises.name: Front Raise And Pullover
exercises.desc: Lie on a flat bench while holding a barbell using a palms down grip that is about 15 inches apart. Place the bar on your upper thighs, extend your arms and lock them while keeping a slight bend on the elbows.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
exercises.desc: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level. Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
exercises.desc: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Looking straight ahead at all times, squat as low as you can and pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
exercises.desc: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift…

exercises.name: Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Gironda Sternum Chins
exercises.desc: Grasp the pull-up bar with a shoulder width underhand grip. Now hang with your arms fully extended and stick your chest out and lean back.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with knees bent, drive through your heels to lift your hips until the body is straight, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.desc: Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Start from the bottom of the movement.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.desc: Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. Squat down between your legs until your hamstrings are on your calves.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.desc: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel.

exercises.name: Good Morning off Pins
exercises.desc: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight.

exercises.name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
exercises.desc: Hang from a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width. Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle so that the calves are parallel to the floor while the thighs remain…

exercises.name: Groin and Back Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet together. Interlock your fingers behind your head.

exercises.name: Groiners
exercises.desc: Begin in a pushup position on the floor. Using both legs, jump forward landing with your feet next to your hands.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.desc: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided. Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The palms of the hands should be facing your torso.

exercises.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
exercises.desc: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with one leg extended above you, with the hip at ninety degrees. Loop a belt, band, or rope over the ball of your foot.

exercises.name: Hamstring-SMR
exercises.desc: In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs. Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Ups
exercises.desc: With your back to the wall bend at the waist and place both hands on the floor at shoulder width. Kick yourself up against the wall with your arms straight.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.desc: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging at the mid thigh position. Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward.

exercises.name: Hang Clean - Below the Knees
exercises.desc: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging just below the knees. Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
exercises.desc: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. Aggressively extend through the legs and hips.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
exercises.desc: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. Aggressively extend through the legs and hips.

exercises.name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
exercises.desc: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your traps.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.desc: Hang from a bar and raise your knees toward your chest by curling the pelvis up; lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.desc: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip. Raise your legs until the torso makes a 90-degree angle with the legs.

exercises.name: Hanging Pike

exercises.name: Heaving Snatch Balance
exercises.desc: This drill helps you learn the snatch. Begin by dipping with the knees slightly, and popping back up to briefly unload the bar.

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Thrust
exercises.desc: Utilize a heavy bag for this exercise. Begin by twisting at the waist, pushing the bag forward as hard as possible.

exercises.name: High Cable Curls
exercises.desc: Stand between a couple of high pulleys and grab a handle in each arm. Curl the handles towards you until they are next to your ears.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.desc: Run in place driving your knees to hip height and pumping your arms as quickly as possible.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-Up
exercises.desc: From a downward-dog position swoop your chest low and forward into an upward dog, then push your hips back up.

exercises.name: Hip Airplane
exercises.desc: Hinge forward on one leg, then rotate your pelvis open and closed under control while balancing.

exercises.name: Hip Circles (prone)
exercises.desc: Position yourself on your hands and knees on the ground. Keeping the knee in a bent position, rotate the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.

exercises.name: Hip Extension with Bands
exercises.desc: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle. Facing the attachment point of the band, hold on to the column to stabilize yourself.

exercises.name: Hip Flexion with Band
exercises.desc: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle. Face away from the attachment point of the band.

exercises.name: Hip Lift with Band
exercises.desc: After choosing a suitable band, lay down in the middle of the rack, after securing the band on either side of you. Adjust your position so that the band is directly over your hips.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.desc: Sit in a hip thrust machine with the pad over your hips and drive your hips up to full extension.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.desc: On your back, press your lower back into the floor and lift shoulders and straight legs a few inches off the ground. Hold.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rock
exercises.desc: From a hollow hold, rock back and forth while keeping the banana-shaped body position.

exercises.name: Hug A Ball
exercises.desc: Seat yourself on the floor. Straddle an exercise ball between both legs and lower your hips down toward the floor.

exercises.name: Hug Knees To Chest
exercises.desc: Lie down on your back and pull both knees up to your chest. Hold your arms under the knees, not over (that would put to much pressure on your knee joints).

exercises.name: Human Flag
exercises.desc: Grip a vertical pole with hands wide, push with the bottom arm and pull with the top to hold your body sideways.

exercises.name: Hurdle Hops
exercises.desc: Set up a row of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart. Stand in front of the first hurdle with your feet shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)

exercises.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
exercises.desc: With someone holding down your legs, slide yourself down to the edge a flat bench until your hips hang off the end of the bench. With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head.

exercises.name: Iliotibial Tract-SMR
exercises.desc: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the hip and the knee. Place as much of your weight as is tolerable onto your bottom leg; there is no need to keep your bottom leg in contact with the ground.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.desc: Stand with your feet close together. Begin by walking your hands forward slowly, alternating your left and your right.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Triceps Extension
exercises.desc: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip (palms down) that is a little closer together than shoulder width. Lie back on an incline bench set at any angle between 45-75-degrees.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Pull
exercises.desc: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and lie face down on an incline bench that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees. Let the arms hang to your sides fully extended as they point to the floor.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
exercises.desc: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles. Begin by extending through the elbow, pressing the handles together straight in front of you.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Flye

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
exercises.desc: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.desc: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length. While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.desc: Hold a dumbbell on each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees. Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist
exercises.desc: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees. Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.desc: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand atop your thighs. Then, using your thighs to help push the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Incline Hammer Curls
exercises.desc: Seat yourself on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Initiate the movement by flexing at the elbow, attempting to keep the upper arm stationary.

exercises.name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
exercises.desc: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie back on an incline bench. The dumbbells should be at arm's length hanging at your sides and your palms should be facing out.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.desc: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform. Position forefoot back from bench or platform with arms and body straight.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (Hands Elevated)
exercises.desc: Hands on a bench, table or wall to make the push-up easier; keep the body rigid and touch your chest to the edge.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Close-Grip
exercises.desc: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place your hands next to one another on the bar.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Depth Jump

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Medium
exercises.desc: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place your hands on the bar, with your hands about shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip
exercises.desc: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place your hands on the bar palms up, with your hands about shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Wide
exercises.desc: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place your hands on the bar, with your hands wider than shoulder width.

exercises.name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring muscles.

exercises.name: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie face down on the floor, with a rope, belt, or band looped around one foot. Flex the knee and extend the hip of the leg to be stretched, using both hands to pull on the belt.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation with Band
exercises.desc: Choke the band around a post. Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.desc: Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. Take a wider than shoulder width grip on the bar and position yourself hanging underneath the bar.

exercises.name: Inverted Row with Straps
exercises.desc: Hang a rope or suspension straps from a rack or other stable object. Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest to your hands.

exercises.name: Iron Cross
exercises.desc: Hold light dumbbells in front of you and raise them out to the sides into a T, keeping arms straight, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Iron Crosses (stretch)

exercises.name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
exercises.desc: While either seating or standing, bend your arms at a 90-degree angle and place the palms of your hands together in front of your chest. Push both hands against each other as you contract your chest.

exercises.name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back

exercises.name: IT Band and Glute Stretch

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit-Up

exercises.name: Janda Sit-Up

exercises.name: Jefferson Squats
exercises.desc: Place a barbell on the floor. Stand in the middle of the bar length wise.

exercises.name: Jerk Balance

exercises.name: Jerk Dip Squat
exercises.desc: This movement strengthens the dip portion of the jerk. Keeping the torso vertical, dip by flexing the knees, allowing them to travel forward and without moving the hips to the rear.

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.desc: Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press. Now beginning from a fully extended position lower the bar down as if performing a lying triceps extension.

exercises.name: Jogging, Treadmill
exercises.desc: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than jogging outside.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.desc: Jump your feet wide while raising arms overhead, then jump back together. Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
exercises.desc: From a lunge, jump and switch legs in the air, landing softly in the opposite lunge.

exercises.name: Keg Load
exercises.desc: To load kegs, place the desired number a distance from the loading platform, typically 30-50 feet. Begin by grabbing the close handle of the first keg, tilting it onto its side to grab the opposite edge of the bottom of the keg.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
exercises.desc: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Looking straight ahead, press the kettlebell out and overhead, rotating your wrist so that your palm faces forward at the top of the motion.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
exercises.desc: Place kettlebell between your feet. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure 8
exercises.desc: Place one kettlebell between your legs and take a wider than shoulder width stance. Pick up a kettlebell and pass it to your other hand between your legs.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat

exercises.name: Kneeling Arm Drill

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
exercises.desc: Hold your legs straight out in front at hip height while doing strict pull-ups.
