exercises.desc: Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell with one hand, with your upper arm supported by the floor. Press the kettlebell straight up toward the ceiling, rotating your wrist.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
exercises.desc: Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
exercises.desc: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Look at the kettlebell and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press
exercises.desc: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Hold the kettlebell with the elbow out to the side, and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Push Press
exercises.desc: Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row
exercises.desc: Place a kettlebell in front of your feet.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.desc: Place a kettlebell between your feet. Look straight ahead and swing the kettlebell back between your legs.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk
exercises.desc: Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Snatch
exercises.desc: Hold a kettlebell in one hand by the handle. Squat towards the floor, and then reverse the motion, extending the hips, knees, and finally the ankles, to raise the kettlebell overhead.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings
exercises.desc: Hinge with a kettlebell in one hand, hike it between your legs and snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.

exercises.name: One-Arm Long Bar Row
exercises.desc: Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Stand next to the bar, and take a grip with one hand close to the collar.

exercises.name: One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.desc: Start in a standing position with a staggered, athletic stance. Begin by winding the arm, raising the medicine ball above your head.

exercises.name: One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.desc: Place one kettlebell between your feet. Grab the handle with one hand and raise the kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palm of your hand.

exercises.name: One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats
exercises.desc: Clean and press a kettlebell with one arm. Looking straight ahead and keeping a kettlebell locked out above you, flex the knees and hips and lower your torso between your legs, keeping your head and chest up.

exercises.name: One-Arm Push-Up
exercises.desc: Feet wide, one hand under the chest; lower and press with one arm while keeping hips square to the floor.

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Deadlift
exercises.desc: Stand to the side of a barbell next to its center. Grasp the bar as if you were grabbing a briefcase (palms facing you since the bar is sideways).

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Laterals
exercises.desc: Pick a dumbbell and place it in one of your hands. Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by your side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you.

exercises.name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
exercises.desc: Hook a leather ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and then attach the cuff to your ankle. Face the weight stack from a distance of about two feet, grasping the steel frame for support.

exercises.name: Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.desc: Place one kettlebell between your feet. Release the kettlebell as it comes up, and let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palms of your hands.

exercises.name: Otis-Up
exercises.desc: Secure your feet and lay back on the floor. Initiate the movement by flexing the hips and spine to raise your torso up from the ground.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl
exercises.desc: To begin, set a weight that is comfortable on each side of the pulley machine. Now adjust the height of the pulleys on each side and make sure that they are positioned at a height higher than that of your shoulders.

exercises.name: Overhead Lat
exercises.desc: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you. Attempt to pull your upper arm to your side as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.

exercises.name: Overhead Slam
exercises.desc: Hold a medine ball with both hands and stand with your feet at shoulder width. Initiate the countermovement by raising the ball above your head and fully extending your body.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.desc: Start out by having a barbell in front of you on the floor. Bend the knees and use a pronated grip (palms facing you) to grab the barbell.

exercises.name: Overhead Stretch
exercises.desc: Standing straight up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to the ceiling. To create a full torso stretch, pull your tailbone down and stabilize your torso as you do this.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps
exercises.desc: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you. Attempt to extend the arm straight into the air as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.desc: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and—if possible—position the cable to shoulder height. With your side to the cable, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the tower.

exercises.name: Pallof Press With Rotation
exercises.desc: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and position the cable to shoulder height. With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower.

exercises.name: Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.desc: Start out by placing two dumbbells on one side of a flat bench. Kneel down on both of your knees so that your body is facing the flat bench.

exercises.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.desc: Start out by placing a barbell on one side of a flat bench. Kneel down on both of your knees so that your body is facing the flat bench.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.desc: Start out by placing a barbell on one side of a flat bench. Kneel down on both of your knees so that your body is facing the flat bench.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.desc: Start out by placing two dumbbells on one side of a flat bench. Kneel down on both of your knees so that your body is facing the flat bench.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dip
exercises.desc: Stand between a set of parallel bars. Begin by flexing the elbow, lowering your body until your arms break 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
exercises.desc: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees. Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
exercises.desc: Shoulders under the pads of a pendulum squat machine; squat deep with feet mid-platform and drive back up.

exercises.name: Peroneals Stretch
exercises.desc: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inside of the foot being pulled towards you.

exercises.name: Peroneals-SMR
exercises.desc: Lay on your side, supporting your weight on your forearm and on a foam roller placed on the outside of your lower leg. Raise your hips off of the ground and begin to roll from below the knee to above the ankle on the side of…

exercises.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
exercises.desc: Lay on a ball so that your upper back is on the ball with your hips unsupported. Begin by extending the hips using your glutes and hamstrings, raising your hips upward as you bridge.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.desc: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, then press back up.

exercises.name: Pin Presses
exercises.desc: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the bench press, developing starting strength. The bench should be set up in a power rack.

exercises.name: Piriformis-SMR
exercises.desc: Sit with your buttocks on top of a foam roll. Shift your weight to the side of the crossed leg, rolling over the buttocks until you feel tension in your upper glute.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.desc: Single-leg squat with the other leg held straight out in front; sit all the way down and stand back up on one leg.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.desc: Forearms under shoulders and body straight from head to heels; brace your abs and squeeze your glutes and hold without letting the hips sag.

exercises.name: Plank Jack
exercises.desc: In a plank, jump your feet wide and back together while keeping hips level.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.desc: In a high plank, tap each hand to the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rock.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
exercises.desc: Grab two wide-rimmed plates and put them together with the smooth sides facing outward Use your fingers to grip the outside part of the plate and your thumb for the other side thus holding both plates together.

exercises.name: Plate Twist
exercises.desc: Lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your legs fully extended and your upper body upright. Slowly cross your legs near your ankles and lift them up off the ground.

exercises.name: Platform Hamstring Slides
exercises.desc: For this movement a wooden floor or similar is needed. Begin the movement by flexing the knee, keeping your other leg straight.

exercises.name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
exercises.desc: Hold a dumbbell at the base with both hands and stand straight up. Your toes should be facing out.

exercises.name: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups
exercises.desc: Place a kettlebell on the floor. Begin by lowering yourself as low as you can, keeping your back straight.

exercises.name: Plyo Push-up
exercises.desc: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes. Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width.

exercises.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
exercises.desc: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outside of the foot being pulled towards you.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.desc: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly. Squat down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip.

exercises.name: Power Clean from Blocks
exercises.desc: With a barbell on boxes of the desired height, take a grip just outside the legs. Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees.

exercises.name: Power Jerk
exercises.desc: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move your head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders.

exercises.name: Power Partials
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The palms of the hands should be facing your torso.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.desc: Begin with a loaded barbell on the floor. Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the ground.

exercises.name: Power Snatch from Blocks
exercises.desc: Begin with a loaded barbell on boxes or stands of the desired height. Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the boxes.

exercises.name: Power Stairs
exercises.desc: In the power stairs, implements are moved up a staircase. Begin by taking the implement with both hands.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.desc: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length.

exercises.name: Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl
exercises.desc: Place the upper part of both arms on top of the preacher bench as you hold a dumbbell in each hand with the palms facing each other (neutral grip). As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells until your upper arm is…

exercises.name: Press Sit-Up
exercises.desc: To begin, lie down on a bench with a barbell resting on your chest. While inhaling, tighten your abdominals and glutes.

exercises.name: Prone Manual Hamstring
exercises.desc: You will need a partner for this exercise. To begin, flex the knee to curl your leg up.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.desc: Face down, lift your arms into a Y, then a T, then a W, squeezing your shoulder blades each time.

exercises.name: Prowler Sprint
exercises.desc: Place your sled on an appropriate surface, loaded to a suitable weight. You may use the upright or the low handles for this exercise.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
exercises.desc: Hands by your waist, fingers turned out, lean your shoulders forward past the hands and do push-ups while keeping the lean.

exercises.name: Pull Through
exercises.desc: Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley with a rope or handle attached. Begin the movement by reaching through your legs as far as possible, bending at the hips.

exercises.name: Pullups
exercises.desc: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders; pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower to a full hang.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.desc: Bar in the front rack; dip a few inches at the knees, then drive up explosively and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.

exercises.name: Push Press - Behind the Neck
exercises.desc: Standing with the weight racked on the back of the shoulders, begin with the dip. Using the momentum generated, finish pressing the weight overhead be extending through the arms.

exercises.name: Push Up to Side Plank
exercises.desc: Get into pushup position on the toes with your hands just outside of shoulder width. Perform a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex.

exercises.name: Push-Up Wide
exercises.desc: With your hands wide apart, support your body on your toes and hands in a plank position. To begin, allow the elbows to flex, lowering your chest to the floor as you inhale.

exercises.name: Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands closer than shoulder width for a close hand position. Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length. Place your toes on top of a flat bench.

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length. Place your toes on top of an exercise ball.

exercises.name: Pushups
exercises.desc: Hands just wider than shoulders, body straight from head to heels; lower your chest to the floor and press back up.

exercises.name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions)
exercises.desc: Lie on the floor face down and body straight with your toes on the floor and the hands wider than shoulder width for a wide hand position and closer than shoulder width for a close hand position. Lower yourself until your…

exercises.name: Pyramid
exercises.desc: Start off by rolling your torso forward onto the ball so your hips rest on top of the ball and become the highest point of your body. Rest your hands and feet on the floor.

exercises.name: Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Lay on your side. With the belt being held over the shoulder or overhead, gently pull to increase the stretch in the quadriceps.

exercises.name: Quadriceps-SMR
exercises.desc: Lay facedown on the floor with your weight supported by your hands or forearms. Shifting as much weight onto the leg to be stretched as is tolerable, roll over the foam from above the knee to below the hip, holding points of…

exercises.name: Quick Leap
exercises.desc: You will need a box for this exerise. Begin facing the box standing 1-2 feet from its edge.

exercises.name: Rack Delivery
exercises.desc: This drill teaches the delivery of the barbell to the rack position on the shoulders. Begin by rotating the elbows around the bar, delivering the bar to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Rack Pull with Bands
exercises.desc: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. Position yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting position.

exercises.name: Rack Pulls
exercises.desc: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. With your head looking forward, extend through the hips and knees, pulling the weight up and back until lockout.

exercises.name: Rear Leg Raises
exercises.desc: Place yourself on your hands knees on an exercise mat. Extend one leg up and behind you.

exercises.name: Recumbent Bike
exercises.desc: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height. Select the desired option from the menu.

exercises.name: Return Push from Stance
exercises.desc: You will need a partner for this drill. Begin in an athletic 2 or 3 point stance.

exercises.name: Reverse Band Bench Press
exercises.desc: Position a bench inside a power rack, with the bar set to the correct height. Lie on the bench, tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back.

exercises.name: Reverse Band Box Squat
exercises.desc: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Reverse Band Deadlift
exercises.desc: Set the bar up in a power rack. Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet.

exercises.name: Reverse Band Power Squat
exercises.desc: Begin in a power rack with the pins and bar set at the appropriate height. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
exercises.desc: Begin with a bar loaded on the floor inside of a power rack. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet.

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at shoulder width with the elbows close to the torso. While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls
exercises.desc: Grab an EZ-bar using a shoulder width and palms down (pronated) grip. Now place the upper part of both arms on top of the preacher bench and have your arms extended.

exercises.name: Reverse Cable Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a bar attachment that is attached to a low pulley using a pronated (palms down) and shoulder width grip. While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while…

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.desc: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to…

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes
exercises.desc: To begin, lie down on an incline bench with the chest and stomach pressing against the incline. Extend the arms in front of you so that they are perpendicular to the angle of the bench.

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes With External Rotation
exercises.desc: To begin, lie down on an incline bench set at a 30-degree angle with the chest and stomach pressing against the incline. Have the dumbbells in each hand with the palms facing down to the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows
exercises.desc: Stand erect while holding a barbell with a supinated grip (palms facing up). Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
exercises.desc: Start by setting a bar attachment (straight or e-z) on a high pulley machine. Facing the bar attachment, grab it with the palms facing up (supinated grip) at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.desc: Place your feet between the pads after loading an appropriate weight. To begin the movement, flex the hips, pulling the legs forward.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.desc: Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90°, then push through the front heel to stand. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Reverse Machine Flyes
exercises.desc: Adjust the handles so that they are fully to the rear. In a semicircular motion, pull your hands out to your side and back, contracting your rear delts.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
exercises.desc: Kneel upright and lean your whole body back in a straight line from knees to head, then pull back up with the quads.

exercises.name: Reverse Plate Curls
exercises.desc: Start by standing straight with a weighted plate held by both hands and arms fully extended. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other and the weighted plate should be near the groin area.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.desc: Lie face down, lift your chest and arms slightly and sweep your arms from your hips to overhead and back like a snow angel.

exercises.name: Reverse Triceps Bench Press
exercises.desc: Lie back on a flat bench. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

exercises.name: Rhomboids-SMR
exercises.desc: Lay down with your back on the floor. Raise your hips off of the ground, placing your weight onto the foam roll.

exercises.name: Rickshaw Carry
exercises.desc: Position the frame at the starting point, and load with the appropriate weight. Immediately begin walking briskly with quick, controlled steps.

exercises.name: Rickshaw Deadlift
exercises.desc: Load the frame with the desired weight. With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees.

exercises.name: Ring Dips
exercises.desc: Begin by flexing the elbow, lowering your body until your arms break 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up
exercises.desc: Push-up with hands on gymnastic rings close to the floor; stabilize the rings and turn them out slightly at the top.

exercises.name: Ring Support Hold
exercises.desc: Hold yourself above rings with arms locked, rings turned out and body straight.

exercises.name: Rocket Jump
exercises.desc: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body. To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible.

exercises.name: Rocking Standing Calf Raise
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Rocky Pull-Ups/Pulldowns
exercises.desc: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a…

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Hold the bar at your hips, soften the knees and push your hips back, sliding the bar down your thighs until you feel a hamstring stretch; stand back up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
exercises.desc: Begin standing while holding a bar at arm's length in front of you. Begin by flexing the knees slightly, and then flex at the hip, moving your butt back as far as possible, lowering the torso as far as flexibility allows.

exercises.name: Rope Climb
exercises.desc: Grab the rope with both hands above your head. Wrap the rope around one leg, using your feet to pinch the rope.

exercises.name: Rope Crunch
exercises.desc: Kneel 1-2 feet in front of a cable system with a rope attached. After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp the rope with both hands reaching overhead.

exercises.name: Rope Jumping
exercises.desc: Hold an end of the rope in each hand. Rope jumping is exciting, challenges your coordination, and requires a lot of energy.

exercises.name: Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.desc: Attach a rope to a high pulley and make your weight selection. Keeping your arms straight, extend the shoulder to pull the rope down to your thighs.

exercises.name: Round The World Shoulder Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand up straight with your legs together, holding a bodybar or broomstick. Hold the pole behind your hips with a wider than shoulder width grip.

exercises.name: Rowing, Stationary
exercises.desc: To begin, seat yourself on the rower. There are three phases of movement when using a rower.

exercises.name: Runner's Stretch
exercises.desc: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor. Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

exercises.name: Running, Treadmill
exercises.desc: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.desc: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs.

exercises.name: Sandbag Load
exercises.desc: To load sandbags or other objects, begin with the implements placed a distance from the loading platform, typically 50 feet. Begin by lifting the sandbag.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
exercises.desc: Take a pronated grip on a pull-up bar. From a hanging position, raise yourself a few inches without using your arms.

exercises.name: Scissor Kick
exercises.desc: To begin, lie down with your back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat (optional). With a slight bend at the knees, lift your legs up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground.

exercises.name: Scissors Jump
exercises.desc: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground. Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot.

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.desc: Lie face down on a high bench and row a barbell or dumbbells up to the underside of the bench.

exercises.name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
exercises.desc: Secure a band close to the ground and place a bench a couple feet away from it. Seat yourself on the bench and secure the band behind your ankles, beginning with your legs straight.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Military Press
exercises.desc: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar behind your head and either have a spotter give you the bar (better on the rotator cuff this way) or pick it up yourself carefully with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Once…

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Twist
exercises.desc: Start out by sitting at the end of a flat bench with a barbell placed on top of your thighs. Grip the bar with your palms facing down and make sure your hands are wider than shoulder width apart from each other.

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.desc: Sit down at the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in one arm using a neutral grip (palms of the hand facing you). Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back…

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
exercises.desc: Place a couple of dumbbells looking forward in front of a flat bench. Sit on the end of the bench with your legs together and the dumbbells behind your calves.

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.desc: Sit down at the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in both arms using a neutral grip (palms of the hand facing you). Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back…

exercises.name: Seated Biceps
exercises.desc: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your partner standing behind you. Attempt to flex your elbows, while your partner prevents any actual movement.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.desc: For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Shoulder Press
exercises.desc: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles. Begin by extending through the elbow, pressing the handles together above your head.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit up straight on an exercise mat. Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.

exercises.name: Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell Curl
exercises.desc: Sit down on a flat bench with a barbell or E-Z Bar in front of you in between your legs. Use your arms to pick the barbell up and place the back of your upper arms on top of your inner thighs (around three and a half inches…

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
exercises.desc: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. Rotate the palms of the hands so that they are facing your torso.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
exercises.desc: Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. Rotate the palms of the hands so that they are facing inward in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl
exercises.desc: Start out by placing two dumbbells on the floor in front of a flat bench. Sit down on the edge of the flat bench with your legs at about shoulder width apart.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
exercises.desc: Throw light, fast punch combinations in the air while moving on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Shotgun Row

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles
exercises.desc: With shoulders relaxed and arms resting loosely at your sides (or in your lap if you're seated), gently roll your shoulders forward, up, back, and down. Reverse direction.

exercises.desc: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward.

exercises.name: Shoulder Raise
exercises.desc: Relax your arms to your sides and raise your shoulders up toward your ears, then back down.

exercises.name: Shoulder Stretch
exercises.desc: Reach your left arm across your body and hold it straight.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squat
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg, hold the other foot behind you and lower until the back knee touches the floor, then stand up.

exercises.name: Side Bridge

exercises.name: Side Hop-Sprint

exercises.name: Side Jackknife
exercises.desc: Lie on your side and simultaneously lift your legs and crunch your upper body toward them, squeezing the obliques.

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Stand with dumbbells at your sides; raise them out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, leading with the elbows, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Side Laterals to Front Raise
exercises.desc: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side. Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises
exercises.desc: Stand next to a chair, which you may hold onto as a support. Keeping your leg straight, raise it as far out to the side as possible, and swing it back down, allowing it to cross the opposite leg.

exercises.name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
exercises.desc: Start off by lying on your right side and bend your right knee in front of you to stabilize the torso. Rest your head on your right hand or shoulder.

exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
exercises.desc: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder. Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.desc: Lie on your side, prop up on your forearm and lift your hips so your body is a straight line. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Standing Long Jump
exercises.desc: Begin standing with your feet hip width apart in an athletic stance. Leaning to your right, extend through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump into the air.

exercises.name: Side to Side Box Shuffle
exercises.desc: Stand to one side of the box with your left foot resting on the middle of it. To begin, jump up and over to the other side of the box, landing with your right foot on top of the box and your left foot on the floor.

exercises.name: Side To Side Chins

exercises.name: Side Wrist Pull
exercises.desc: This stretch works best standing. Slowly straighten, pull, and lift it up to shoulder height, as pictured.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Floor Stretch
exercises.desc: First lie on your left side, bending your left knee in front of you to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright). Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind your left.

exercises.name: Single Dumbbell Raise
exercises.desc: With a wide stance, hold a dumbell with both hands, grasping the head of the dumbbell instead of the handle. Raise the weight until it is above shoulder level, keeping your arms extended.

exercises.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
exercises.desc: Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised. Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg.

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: Lay on the floor with your feet flat and knees bent. Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to your chest.

exercises.name: Single Leg Push-off
exercises.desc: Stand on the ground with one foot resting on the box, heel close to the edge. Push off with your foot on top of the box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through the hip and knee.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover
exercises.desc: Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position, select the resistance to be used, and take a handle in each hand. Step forward in front of both pulleys with your arms extended in front of you, bringing your hands together.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Linear Jammer

exercises.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
exercises.desc: Begin laying prone on the ground. Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back.

exercises.name: Single-Cone Sprint Drill
exercises.desc: This drill teaches quick foot action. Chop the feet as quickly as possible, blocking with the arms.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Calf raise on one leg from a step, holding something for balance; full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg High Box Squat
exercises.desc: Position a box in a rack. Standing in front of it, step onto the box to a full standing position, letting your other leg remain unsupported.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.desc: Upper back on a bench, one foot planted; drive the hips up on one leg, squeeze the glute at the top and lower.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hop Progression
exercises.desc: Arrange a line of cones in front of you. Hop forward, jumping and landing with the same leg over the cone.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop
exercises.desc: Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle. To begin, execute a counterjump to hop sideways over the cone.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension

exercises.name: Sissy Squat

exercises.name: Skater Jump
exercises.desc: Leap sideways from one leg to the other like a speed skater, landing softly and reaching across.

exercises.name: Skating
exercises.desc: Roller skating is a fun activity which can be effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular endurance. You can skate at a comfortable pace for 30 minutes straight.

exercises.name: Skin the Cat
exercises.desc: From a hang, lift legs and rotate backward through your arms as far as comfortable, then return slowly.

exercises.desc: Attach dual handles to a sled connected by a rope or chain. Face the sled, backing up until there is some tension in the line.

exercises.desc: Attach dual handles to a sled using a chain or rope. Facing away from the sled, step away until there is tension in the line.

exercises.name: Sled Push

exercises.name: Split Clean

exercises.name: Squat Jerk

exercises.name: Squat Thrust
exercises.desc: Squat, place hands down, kick feet back to a plank, jump them back in and stand. A burpee without push-up or jump.

exercises.name: Squat with Bands
exercises.desc: Set up the bands on the sleeves, secured to either band pegs, the rack, or dumbbells so that there is appropriate tension. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.desc: To set up the chains, begin by looping the leader chain over the sleeves of the bar. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.desc: To begin, first set the bar on a rack to just below shoulder level. Hold on to the bar with both hands and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straighten your torso.

exercises.desc: To start out, make sure that the exercise band is at an even split between both the left and right side of the body. When holding the bands, they should be the same height on each side.

exercises.name: Stairmaster

exercises.desc: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand. Extend one arm to press the dumbbell straight up, keeping your off hand in place.

exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.desc: Clasp your hands behind your back with your palms together, straighten arms and then rotate them so your palms face downward. Raise your arms up and hold until you feel a stretch in your biceps.

exercises.name: Standing Bradford Press

exercises.name: Standing Cable Wood Chop
exercises.desc: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and move the cable to the highest pulley position. With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower.

exercises.name: Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch
exercises.desc: Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot. Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
exercises.desc: Begin standing on one leg, holding to a vertical support. Raise the unsupported knee to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexors
exercises.desc: Stand up straight with the spine vertical, the left foot slightly in front of the right. Bend both knees and lift the back heel off the floor as you press the right hip forward.

exercises.name: Standing Inner-Biceps Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. Rotate the palms of the hands so that they are facing inward in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Stretch
exercises.desc: Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent. Place your right hand on your right hip to support the spine.

exercises.name: Standing Long Jump
exercises.desc: This drill is best done in sand or other soft landing surface. Utilizing a big arm swing and a countermovement of the legs, jump forward as far as you can.

exercises.name: Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise
exercises.desc: Start by standing to the right side of a low pulley row. Make sure that your back is erect and your feet are shoulder width apart from each other.

exercises.name: Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Extension

exercises.name: Standing Military Press
exercises.desc: Bar at shoulder height, grip just outside shoulders; brace your glutes and abs and press the bar straight overhead, moving your head through at the top.

exercises.name: Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze
exercises.desc: To begin, stand straight while holding a weight plate by the ridge at arm's length in each hand using a neutral grip (palms facing in). Lower the plates until the fingers are nearly extended but can still hold weights.

exercises.name: Standing One-Arm Cable Curl
exercises.desc: Start out by grabbing single handle next to the low pulley machine. Make sure that your upper arm is stationary, perpendicular to the floor with elbows in and palms facing forward.

exercises.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incline Bench
exercises.desc: Stand on the back side of an incline bench as if you were going to be a spotter for someone. Position your non lifting hand at the corner or side of the incline bench.

exercises.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extension

exercises.name: Standing Palm-In One-Arm Dumbbell Press
exercises.desc: Start by having a dumbbell in one hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other.

exercises.name: Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press
exercises.desc: Start by having a dumbbell in each hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip. Continue to maintain a neutral grip throughout the entire exercise.

exercises.name: Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl

exercises.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
exercises.desc: Start off with your feet hip-distance apart. Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.

exercises.name: Standing Rope Crunch
exercises.desc: Attach a rope to a high pulley and select an appropriate weight. Stand with your back to the cable tower.

exercises.name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other. Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor.

exercises.name: Standing Toe Touches
exercises.desc: Stand with some space in front and behind you. Bend at the waist, keeping your legs straight, until you can relax and let your upper body hang down in front of you.

exercises.name: Standing Towel Triceps Extension
exercises.desc: To begin, stand up with both arms fully extended above the head holding one end of a towel with both hands. Now communicate with your partner so that he/she can grip the other side of the towel to apply resistance.

exercises.name: Standing Two-Arm Overhead Throw
exercises.desc: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball in both hands. Violently throw the ball forward, flexing at the hip and using your whole body to complete the movement.

exercises.name: Star Jump
exercises.desc: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body. To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible.

exercises.name: Step-up with Knee Raise
exercises.desc: Stand facing a box or bench of an appropriate height with your feet together. Begin the movement by stepping up, putting your left foot on the top of the bench.

exercises.name: Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
exercises.desc: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance.

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.desc: Grasp a couple of dumbbells holding them by your side at arm's length. Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance.

exercises.name: Stomach Vacuum

exercises.name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows
exercises.desc: Place a loaded barbell on the end of a bench. Row the bar to your torso by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows.

exercises.name: Straight Bar Dip
exercises.desc: Support yourself on a single straight bar, lean slightly forward and dip until the bar is near your chest, then press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Straight Raises on Incline Bench
exercises.desc: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench. Lay on the bench face down.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown

exercises.name: Stride Jump Crossover
exercises.desc: Stand to the side of a box with your inside foot on top of it, close to the edge. Begin by swinging the arms upward as you push through the top leg, jumping upward as high as possible.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.desc: Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
exercises.desc: To deadlift with short bands, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. Begin with a bar loaded on the ground.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift with Chains
exercises.desc: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift. Begin with a bar loaded on the ground.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.desc: To begin, lie straight and face down on the floor or exercise mat. Simultaneously raise your arms, legs, and chest off of the floor and hold this contraction for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Supine Chest Throw
exercises.desc: This drill is great for chest passes when you lack a partner or a wall of sufficient strength. Begin with the ball on your chest, held with both hands on the bottom.

exercises.name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
exercises.desc: Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent. Initiate the movement at the shoulder, throwing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance.

exercises.name: Supine Two-Arm Overhead Throw
exercises.desc: Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent. Hold the ball with both hands, extending the arms fully behind your head.

exercises.name: Suspended Fallout
exercises.desc: Adjust the straps so the handles are at an appropriate height, below waist level. Begin standing and grasping the handles.

exercises.name: Suspended Push-Up
exercises.desc: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object. Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a push-up plank position.

exercises.name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
exercises.desc: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Place your feet into the handles.

exercises.name: Suspended Row
exercises.desc: Suspend your straps at around chest height. Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement.

exercises.name: Suspended Split Squat
exercises.desc: Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from the floor. Facing away from the setup, place your rear foot into the handle behind you.

exercises.name: Svend Press
exercises.desc: Begin in a standing position. Press two lightweight plates together with your hands.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row with Handle
exercises.desc: Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Stand over the bar, and position a Double D row handle around the bar next to the collar.

exercises.name: Tate Press

exercises.name: The Straddle
exercises.desc: Begin in a seated, upright position. With your hands on the floor, lean forward as far as possible.

exercises.name: Thigh Abductor
exercises.desc: To begin, sit down on the abductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with. Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them away from each other while exhaling.

exercises.name: Thigh Adductor
exercises.desc: To begin, sit down on the adductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with. Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them towards each other while exhaling.

exercises.name: Tire Flip
exercises.desc: Begin by gripping the bottom of the tire on the tread, and position your feet back a bit. To lift the tire, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles, driving into the tire and up.

exercises.name: Toe Touchers
exercises.desc: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your legs should be touching each other.

exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar
exercises.desc: Hang from a bar and lift straight legs until your toes touch the bar, controlling the descent.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation
exercises.desc: Stand upright holding an exercise ball with both hands. Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your eyes on the ball as you move.

exercises.name: Towel Row
exercises.desc: Loop a towel around a sturdy post or closed-door handle, lean back holding both ends and row yourself in.

exercises.name: Trail Running/Walking
exercises.desc: Running or hiking on trails will get the blood pumping and heart beating almost immediately. A 150 lb person can burn over 200 calories for 30 minutes walking uphill, compared to 175 on a flat surface.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.desc: For this exercise load a trap bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on the ground. Lower your hips, look forward with your head and keep your chest up.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Shrug
exercises.desc: Stand inside a trap bar, hold the handles and shrug your shoulders straight up, pausing at the top.

exercises.name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.desc: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing your torso. Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and use your triceps to lift the weights until the arm is fully extended.

exercises.name: Tricep Side Stretch
exercises.desc: Bring right arm across your body and over your left shoulder, holding your elbow with your left hand, until you feel a stretch in your tricep.

exercises.name: Triceps Overhead Extension with Rope
exercises.desc: Attach a rope to a low pulley. Position your hands behind your head with your elbows point straight up.

exercises.desc: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull.

exercises.name: Tuck L-Sit
exercises.desc: Easier L-sit: support on straight arms with knees tucked to the chest and feet off the floor. Hold.

exercises.name: Tuck Planche
exercises.desc: Hands on the floor or parallettes, lean forward and lift both feet with knees tucked to the chest, arms straight. Hold.

exercises.desc: Grab a dumbbell with each arm and place the upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.desc: Place two kettlebells between your feet. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebells towards your shoulders.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
exercises.desc: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press
exercises.desc: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Press the kettlebells up and out.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row
exercises.desc: Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Grab both kettlebells and pull them to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blades and flexing the elbows.

exercises.name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
exercises.desc: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Grab the pull-down bar with the palms facing your torso (a supinated grip).

exercises.name: Upper Back Stretch
exercises.desc: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.

exercises.name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
exercises.desc: While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms. Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees.

exercises.name: Upright Barbell Row
exercises.desc: Grasp a barbell with an overhand grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. Now exhale and use the sides of your shoulders to lift the bar, raising your elbows up and to the side.

exercises.name: Upright Cable Row
exercises.desc: Grasp a straight bar cable attachment that is attached to a low pulley with a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. Use your side shoulders to lift the cable bar as you exhale.

exercises.name: Upright Row - With Bands
exercises.desc: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Use your side shoulders to lift the handles as you exhale.

exercises.name: Upward Stretch
exercises.desc: Extend both hands straight above your head, palms touching. Slowly push your hands up and back, keeping your back straight.

exercises.desc: Lying flat, lift your straight legs and torso at the same time to touch your toes at the top, then lower.

exercises.name: Walking, Treadmill

exercises.desc: Kick or walk up into a handstand against a wall; push tall through the shoulders, squeeze glutes and hold.

exercises.desc: Back flat against a wall, slide down until knees and hips are at 90° and hold.

exercises.desc: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your torso pressing against the ball and parallel to the floor. Slowly raise your torso up by bending at the waist and lower back.

exercises.name: Weighted Ball Side Bend

exercises.name: Weighted Jump Squat
exercises.desc: Position a lightly loaded barbell across the back of your shoulders. The weight should be light enough that it doesn't slow you down significantly.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull Ups
exercises.desc: Attach a weight to a dip belt and secure it around your waist. You'll want to bring your torso back about 30 degrees while creating a curvature in your lower back and sticking your chest out.

exercises.name: Weighted Sissy Squat

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands
exercises.desc: Start out by strapping the bands around the base of the decline bench. Position your legs through the decline machine until they are secured.

exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

exercises.name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
exercises.desc: Begin with a barbell loaded on the floor. Begin the movement be engaging the hips, driving them forward as you allow the arms to hang straight.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
exercises.desc: Lie back on a flat bench with feet firm on the floor. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.desc: Lie back on a decline bench with the feet securely locked at the front of the bench. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Pullover
exercises.desc: Lie down on a decline bench with both legs securely locked in position. When positioned properly, your arms should be fully extended and perpendicular to the floor.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.desc: Sit with thighs under the pads, grip the bar wide; pull it to your upper chest by driving the elbows down, then let it rise under control.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.desc: Pull-up with hands well outside shoulder width; drive elbows down and pull your chest toward the bar.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck
exercises.desc: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip.

exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at the wide outer handle. While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Wind Sprints
exercises.desc: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can.

exercises.name: Windmills
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and your legs straight. Lift one leg and quickly cross it over your body, attempting to touch the ground near the opposite hand.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper
exercises.desc: Hang or lie with legs raised and rotate them side to side under control like a windshield wiper.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.desc: This is a three-part stretch. Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
exercises.desc: Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other. Keeping your entire body stationary except for the wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
exercises.desc: To begin, stand straight up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Slowly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor in front of you.

exercises.name: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar
exercises.desc: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width. Alternating between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper.

exercises.name: Yoke Walk
exercises.desc: The yoke is usually done with a yoke apparatus, but is sometimes seen with refrigerators or other heavy objects. Begin by racking the apparatus across the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Zercher Squats
exercises.desc: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. Lift the bar up so that it is resting on top of your forearms.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
exercises.desc: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. Make sure the palms of the hands are facing each other.

exercises.name: Zottman Preacher Curl
